applicability: Display preferences and expression inspection during one mounted review workspace.
conditions: Workspace state survives comparison-page reads and diff-layout switches.
Closing an expanded expression returns focus to its retained opener when that element is available.
exclusions: These transient display choices are not persisted knowledge or durable cross-session preferences.
statement: Diff layout and full-file disclosure are workspace state, with changed regions as the default and focus retained when an expression closes.
